title: Fix trace-sampling regression and dashboard heatmap drift causing missing incident metrics
creator: Asha Raman
description: Summary: Multiple customers reported missing metrics and intermittent blank heatmap tiles in the Console live panels during two separate incidents (one on Hosted, one on Dedicated). Tracing gaps were observed for sampled requests; spans were present in raw traces but the aggregated sampling index used by the dashboard heatmap dropped low-volume trace buckets after a recent collector config rollout. Affected surfaces: Live panels (heatmap tiles), per-route latency SLO graphs, and span-level trace links in the Console. Impact: Customers saw gaps in incident timelines and incorrectly calculated percentiles during ongoing outages, leading to escalations to Support and Sales.
steps_to_reproduce: Deploy the latest collector image (collector:2025.03.07) with sampling-config:weight-decay=0.03 in a test cluster
Replay a mixed traffic workload with 1% of requests marked as high-cardinality (user-provided metadata)
Open Console live panel for the route and observe heatmap tiles for 1-minute buckets; low-volume buckets are missing or show zero counts
Open span trace sample list and note missing sampled IDs despite raw span ingestion being present in the trace store
root_cause: A configuration change in the metrics/trace collector lowered the sampling retention priority for low-cardinality buckets and introduced an unintended TTL-based eviction in the heatmap aggregator. Combined with a recent metrics index compaction change, this caused older bucket keys to be compacted away before Console aggregation, producing blank tiles and broken trace linking. The regression was introduced in collector:2025.03.07 when an optimization intended to reduce memory use incorrectly shared a TTL map across collector instances.
mitigation_actions: Hotfix rolled out: reverted collector sampling weight-decay to previous value and disabled cross-instance TTL sharing (PR #4852)
Invalidate and rebuild heatmap cache for affected routes (backfill job heatmap-backfill-2025-03-12) to repopulate 2 hours of lost tiles
Temporarily increased sampling retention for trace backend to keep additional low-volume buckets for 6 hours
Opened priority support channel and sent customer notifications with interim guidance and ETA
